title: Chatrix
description: This mod completely overhauls Minecraft's chat system, adding a separate global and private chat.
body:
# Chatrix
## Modern Chat for Minecraft

Tired of losing private messages in a cluttered global chat?
Chatrix transforms Minecraft’s outdated chat into a clean, organized messenger with tabs, notifications, and a modern interface — all while staying true to vanilla style.


# Core Features

## 🗂️ Tab-Based Chat
- Separate Global and Private conversations
- Automatic detection of /msg and /tell
- Each player gets their own private tab
- No more mixed or lost messages

## 💬 Clean Messenger UI
- Easily switch between conversations with different players
- Focused, distraction-free chat experience
- System clutter is removed for better readability
- Designed for fast and comfortable communication

## 🛠️ Vanilla-Friendly Design
- Compact chat width (like vanilla)
- Proper word wrapping (no overlap or broken text)
- Fits naturally into the Minecraft UI

## 🔔 Notifications
Unread messages are marked with a red dot
Works even while you're in another tab
Simple and non-intrusive
